description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notice  published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2059/32 - Excise Duty on Non-Portable Spirits was passed on 07.06.2018
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of excise duties and regulatory rules for non-potable spirits under the Excise Ordinance. It contains legal/regulatory matters including new regulations, amendments to existing rules, licensing requirements, and enforcement procedures. While it mentions the Minister of Finance, it does so only in the context of the regulatory authority issuing these rules, without detailing personal appointments or portfolio responsibilities. The content fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it establishes a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for alcohol imports and handling.
